runs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: 3D texture-source albedo painting, BACK view of a derelict swarmship's stern half.
Produce exactly ONE 1024 x 1024 PNG with a genuinely transparent background, at native output size.

INPUTS, IN ORDER:
1. guide_back.png: EDIT TARGET and absolute authority for every pixel of the object's silhouette, orthographic camera, position, size, surface edge, opening and shape.
2. design_reference.png: approved material, colour and design reference ONLY. Do not borrow its pose, silhouette, framing or lighting.
3. concept_crop.png: original concept supporting reference ONLY. Do not copy its background or illumination.

Paint ONLY the existing grey model surfaces of input 1, matching the weathered grey-brown chitin and bone plates, darker spines, black-violet resin webbing inside existing openings, and dust of input 2. Preserve the exact alpha mask of input 1, including all outer contours and transparent holes. All geometry stays exactly where it is in the guide. Do not reconstruct or redesign the hull; this is a texture painting over the supplied model render.

COMPOSITION LOCK:
Keep the entire 1024-square canvas unchanged. The object occupies approximately x=66 to 958 and y=229 to 795; preserve the large transparent margins above and below. The narrow pointed end faces lower left and the tall broken stern end is on the right. The five long curved dorsal spines rise towards the right, and a small hook is at lower left. Follow their exact widths, curves, tips, connecting surfaces, triangular teeth, broken angular lower edges, long diagonal hull strake and round recessed side openings. Preserve the unusual thin sheet and triangular opening between the uppermost right spines as modeled. Every edge and opening must coincide with the guide. Do not add strands, chips or details outside the existing silhouette. Do not fill transparent spaces between spines. Do not crop, recenter, zoom, rotate, mirror or change the perspective.

MATERIAL PAINT:
Use matte, dusty weathered grey-brown chitin/bone plates with fine worn longitudinal grain, surface cracks and restrained ochre-brown worn seams; darker grey-brown spines; dark black-violet resin fibers/webbing painted only onto the modeled recessed surfaces in the existing openings. Follow the design reference's material identity, at the guide's simpler exact geometry. Surface detail is colour texture only, not new protruding geometry. Keep the restrained grey-brown and black-violet palette rather than orange scene lighting or shiny gold.

LIGHTING IS CRITICAL:
This is a flat albedo texture source, not a beauty render. Even, flat, shadowless frontal illumination. Remove the guide's shaded-lighting appearance. No cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no directional gradient, no strong specular highlights or reflections, no rim light. Dark resin is dark by material pigment, not by shading. Any existing glowing parts are painted at their glowing colour without light cast onto surroundings. No background colour, no scenery, no floor, no ground shadow, no haze, no text, no labels and no watermark. The background and all originally transparent openings remain genuinely transparent.

Return the unresized 1024 x 1024 painting only.
